svg.aria-label: The 1977 BPTI study examined atomic fluctuations in a folded protein. This figure explores the same type of question with the present fitted ubiquitin trajectory: three times at a shared scale, and three-dimensional distances of Gly76 and Ile23 from their own full-window means.
